correctness.finding: The package does not establish its universal headline “stable for every Δ in [0,5]”. The eigenvalue artifact contains spectra at only 11 discrete Δ values on one coarse stability grid (NV=120,NQ=11); no interval bound, Lipschitz control, continuation certificate, or interval arithmetic excludes a crossing between samples. In addition, the computation clips the stated Lorentzian at |η|=30; at Δ=5 an untruncated Cauchy/Lorentzian has about 10.5% of its mass outside that range, so the implemented model is materially different. The archived spike_metrics.json also contains one metric row per Δ, not the claimed two-seed dataset.

originality.finding: The exact parameter-point scan may well be unpublished, but priority cannot rescue a theorem whose continuum exclusion is not proved for the stated model. I found no decisive prior that by itself settles this exact (K0,g,I0,Δ) slice, so originality is left unresolved rather than inferred from search absence.

scientific_value.finding: The sampled branch/eigenvalue data are potentially useful exploratory evidence that this operating point is far from a Hopf bifurcation at the tested Δ values, but the accepted record claims a complete negative resolution over a continuum. Without a certified continuation/exclusion for the untruncated model, that stronger finding is not scientifically validated.
